name: QA-1124-EPD-01: EPD set in the Offer phase appears in the generated contract
description:
Objective: QA-1124-EPD-01: EPD set in the Offer phase appears in the generated contract.
Preconditions: Open Epd revision contract regressions with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Epd revision contract regressions.
2. QA-1124-EPD-01: EPD set in the Offer phase appears in the generated contract.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: A new automation application: the broker accepts with an EPD request, the underwriter configures the EPD while the application is still in the Offer phase, then the contract is generated and downloaded. Every EPD month (discount % and discounted COB) must be i.
